name: leadpilot-ai
description: Prioritize sales conversations, draft grounded follow-ups, prepare booking options, and create concise sales briefings.

interface.longDescription: LeadPilot AI helps salespeople, founders, agencies, consultants, and small businesses prioritize explicitly supplied sales conversations, identify prospects waiting for a reply, draft grounded follow-up messages, prepare meeting options from verified availability, and create concise sales briefings. The current public version is read-only: it does not access Gmail, contacts, or calendars on its own, send messages, create calendar events, or invent missing commercial information.
defaultPrompt: Rank these sales leads and explain the strongest buying signals.
Which of these conversations need a reply first?
Create a concise sales briefing from this lead data.
